jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.empty: No jobs yet. Imports, analysis and renders will show up here.

system.title: System status
system.start_hint: Start the backend from the backend folder:

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Import long videos and follow their progress.
library.drop_hint: MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM and other common formats. A quick check runs right away; processing only starts when you press Start.
library.location_label: Or import from a link or a file path
library.location_hint: Links are downloaded with yt-dlp. A file path on this computer is used in place, without copying.
library.imported: “{{name}}” imported. Check the results, then press Start.
library.download_queued: Download queued. The video will appear when it is ready.
library.empty: No videos yet. Drop a long video above or paste a link to get started.
library.notes_placeholder: e.g. focus on the funniest parts; the guest's name is Lan
library.rerun_body: This step and every step after it will run again. Results that are already cached are reused.
library.delete_body: The source, its transcript and its moments will be removed from the library.
library.delete_media: Also delete the media files the app created (preview copy, audio, uploaded or downloaded video)
library.delete_media_external: The original file at {{path}} is never deleted.
library.waiting_body: Run this command in Claude Code. The moments appear here automatically when Claude writes moments.json.
library.command_copied: Command copied — paste it into Claude Code
library.command_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Run this in Claude Code: {{command}}
library.find_offline_hint: Use the built-in heuristic instead (no AI, lower quality)

moments.title: Moments
moments.subtitle: Review the moments the AI proposed.
moments.empty: No moments yet. Import a video in the Library first.
moments.none_yet: No moments yet. Select text in the transcript or click “New” to add one.
moments.not_ready: This video is still being processed.
moments.new_moment_hint: Add a 15 s moment at the playhead
moments.preview916_hint: Show the expected vertical crop (centered until reframing is computed)
moments.no_proxy: Preview video is not ready yet
moments.find_again_hint: Ask for new proposals (approved and manual moments are kept)
moments.find_again_body: Proposed and rejected moments will be replaced by new proposals. Approved and manually added moments are kept.
moments.set_in: Set the in point at the playhead
moments.set_out: Set the out point at the playhead
moments.alt_hint: drag; hold Alt to turn off snapping
moments.timeline_legend: Grey = silence · orange = scene cut · drag the handles to trim
moments.select_hint: Select a moment on the left to review it.
moments.approve_open_hint: Approve this moment and edit it as a clip
moments.select_to_create: Select text to create a moment
moments.no_transcript: No transcript for this video. You can still add moments on the timeline.

editor.title: Clip Editor
editor.subtitle: Fine-tune framing, captions, hook and voice.
editor.empty: No clip open. Approve a moment to start editing.
editor.pick_subtitle: Pick a clip to edit. Clips are created when you approve a moment.
editor.no_clips: No clips yet for this source. Approve a moment first.
editor.back_hint: Back to Moments, at the same position
editor.safe_zones_hint: Dim the areas covered by the platform's buttons and captions
editor.split_segment: Split the segment at the playhead
editor.last_segment: A clip needs at least one segment.
editor.reframe_failed: Automatic framing failed. The current framing is kept.
editor.recompute_hint: Analyze the video again and replace the keyframes
editor.recompute_body: This replaces your manual keyframes with new automatic ones. You can undo it.

mode_hint.auto: Follow the face or the active speaker
mode_hint.manual: Place the crop yourself with keyframes
mode_hint.split: Two source regions stacked top and bottom

method.already_vertical: Source is already vertical: framing kept
method.blur_fallback: Cursor rarely visible: whole frame on a blurred background

editor.kept_manual: You edited the framing while it was computing, so your version was kept.
editor.split_hint: Drag a region to move it, the corner to resize it, or draw it again.
editor.drawing_top: Drag on the source video to draw the top region. Esc cancels.
editor.drawing_bottom: Drag on the source video to draw the bottom region. Esc cancels.

view_hint.crop: Drag the box to move the framing, scroll to zoom. A keyframe is set at the playhead.
view_hint.split: Move or resize the two regions on the source video.
view_hint.blur: Whole frame on a blurred background. Switch Fit to Fill to crop instead.

editor.fit_hint: Fill crops to 9:16; Blur shows the whole frame on a blurred copy
editor.fit_blur_note: Blurred background: the whole frame is shown
editor.keyframes_hint: x, y = crop center (0–1), zoom 1 = largest crop
editor.add_keyframe: Add a keyframe at the playhead
editor.target_lufs_hint: Platforms play shorts at about −14 LUFS
editor.isolate_hint: Clean up the original audio with ElevenLabs (uses credits, asks first)
editor.duck_db: Lower the original audio under the voiceover
editor.duck_hint: How much quieter the original audio gets while the voiceover plays
editor.duck_note: Applies once a voiceover is added (Voice tab).

later.voice: ElevenLabs voiceover arrives in a later update.
later.export: Rendering arrives in a later update.

editor.position_hint: You can also drag the dashed line on the 9:16 preview.
editor.find_hint: Matches inside words too, not case sensitive.
editor.no_words: No words in this clip. The transcript may be empty for this range.
editor.blocks_hint: The block at the playhead ({{time}}) is highlighted. Edit text, timing, or click a word to emphasize it.
editor.hook_placeholder: A short line that makes people stay

export.title: Export
export.subtitle: Render clips and export bundles for CapCut.
export.empty: Nothing to export yet. Approved clips will appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Preferences for this computer.
settings.language_hint: Applies right away and is remembered on this computer.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.empty: No speech was found in this video.
transcript.hint: Click a word to jump there in the video.
transcript.no_proxy: The preview copy isn't ready yet.

errors.BACKEND_UNREACHABLE: Can't reach the backend. Is it running?
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the backend. Check the log for details.
errors.FFMPEG_NOT_FOUND: FFmpeg was not found. Install it and add it to PATH, or set FFMPEG_BIN in .env.
errors.FFPROBE_NOT_FOUND: FFprobe was not found. It ships with FFmpeg; add it to PATH, or set FFPROBE_BIN in .env.
errors.GPU_NOT_AVAILABLE: No supported GPU found. Everything still works on the CPU, just slower.
errors.DISK_SPACE_LOW: Not enough disk space: about {{needed_gb, number}} GB needed, only {{free_gb, number}} GB free.
errors.PROBE_FAILED: Couldn't read “{{name}}”. The file may be damaged or may not be a video.
errors.INVALID_DURATION: The video's duration could not be determined.
errors.NO_VIDEO_STREAM: This file has no video track.
errors.NO_AUDIO_STREAM: This video has no audio. Transcription will be skipped, but you can still add moments by hand on the timeline.
errors.VIDEO_DECODE_FAILED: The video track ({{codec}}) can't be decoded. Try converting the file to H.264 MP4.
errors.AUDIO_DECODE_FAILED: The audio track ({{codec}}) can't be decoded. Try converting the file to MP4 with AAC audio.
errors.LOW_RESOLUTION: Low resolution ({{width}}×{{height}}). Vertical crops may look soft.
errors.VARIABLE_FRAME_RATE: Variable frame rate detected. The preview copy will be converted to a constant frame rate.
errors.SOURCE_ALREADY_VERTICAL: This video is already vertical, so reframing will be skipped.
errors.VERY_LONG_VIDEO: Long video ({{hours, number}} h). The transcript will be analyzed in parts.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: “{{name}}” doesn't look like a video file.
errors.INVALID_LOCATION: Enter a web link (http/https) or the full path of a video file on this computer.
errors.UPLOAD_FAILED: The upload didn't finish. Please try again.
errors.DISK_FULL: The disk is full. The job was stopped and its temporary files were removed.
errors.SOURCE_BUSY: This source is busy with another job. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
errors.SOURCE_NOT_STARTABLE: This source can't be processed. Check the preflight results.
errors.JOB_CANCELLED: Cancelled. Press Start to continue where it stopped.
errors.JOB_FAILED: The job failed unexpectedly. Open the log for details.
errors.STEP_NOT_AVAILABLE: This step arrives in a later build.
errors.PROXY_FAILED: Couldn't create the preview copy. Open the log for details.
errors.TRANSCRIBE_SKIPPED_NO_AUDIO: No audio track, so transcription was skipped.
errors.NO_SPEECH_FOUND: No speech was found. You can still add moments by hand.
errors.TRANSCRIBE_CPU_FALLBACK: The GPU couldn't be used for transcription, so the CPU was used (slower).
errors.CONTENT_TYPE_FAILED: Couldn't detect the content type automatically. Pick it on the card.
errors.MOMENTS_SKIPPED_NO_TRANSCRIPT: No transcript, so no moments were proposed. You can add moments by hand on the timeline.
errors.MOMENTS_INVALID: moments.json is not valid: {{detail}}. Run /find-moments again.
errors.MOMENTS_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: The moment finder “{{provider}}” isn't set up (missing API key or server). Choose another one in Settings.
errors.MOMENTS_FEWER_THAN_WANTED: Only {{count}} moments were found. You can add more by hand.
errors.ANALYSIS_NOT_READY: The analysis for this video isn't ready yet.
errors.MOMENTS_DUPLICATES_DROPPED: {{count}} of {{total}} proposals were dropped: duplicates of a better one, too short, or already covered by your moments.
errors.CLIP_BUSY: This clip is still being processed. Try again in a moment.
errors.PREPARE_FAILED: Could not cut the clip from the source: {{detail}}
